description: Stops a test (or settles a finished one) and keeps one arm. keep a leaves the page as it is. keep b applies the change: for a test on one app, its order, featured card and Shop the post order become that app's own (bio_variant_set); a new name, picture or look, or any change tested on every app, changes the page for everyone. Pinned links keep their places. Undo puts the page back and the test as it was.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: bio_test_stop
title: Stop a link page test
